scope: Readonly static source review; producer not executed; no market feature results or outcome labels read

checks.finding: past_return_k uses t-k and t only; MA20 uses current-inclusive 20 observations
emit tests bad primary observation IDs in exact dependencies, preserves diagnostic and sets engineering NULL with ready=0
relative combines two component dependency lists and rechecks bad IDs; component conflicts are propagated despite using diagnostic values
ex-date resets segment before appending current close; past5 requires 6 same-segment observations; indices never inherit stock resets
eight source-symbol date lists must be nonempty, unique, sorted and identical; collection/adjustment/unit/positive finite prices checked
producer includes prefix reconstruction on five fixed dates and post-2024 price-poison check; static loop reads no future closes for earlier feature values
prepare compares cfg to current contract; main also verifies registration contract/code hashes and protected input hashes, preventing silent contract or implementation change
main SELECT explicitly reads market_daily close/source fields and corporate_actions ex-dates only; no outcome table reads, fit or scoring

nonblocking_notes.note: The test named no_price_conflict_silently_promoted currently iterates rows already labelled CLOSE_SOURCE_CONFLICT; adding the reverse implication for every row with conflict_n>0 would make testing stronger. The emit implementation itself currently handles this correctly.

prepare rejects the entire batch if any input close is nonpositive/nonfinite. This is stricter than per-feature missing-value NULL handling and should be stated in documentation; it does not alter current frozen valid source data.
